title: Temporary closure spare parts store
summary: Due to a system change we have to close our spare parts store temporarily from 30.10. - 07.11.2023.
body_markdown:
##### **16.10.2023**


# Temporary closure spare parts store


Due to a system change, we have to close our spare parts store for one week.


Please note that between 30.10. – 07.11.2023 no spare parts can be ordered and shipped.


From 08.11.2023 our colleagues are again available for you as usual under Tel: +49 89 905094 55 andersatzteile@hurco.de .
